notes: Source-of-truth catalog for the style parity pass. It currently covers GPUI 0.2.2 padding, margin, gap, size, position/inset, display, visibility, overflow, cursor, border width/style, border radius, named/hex/linear-gradient background/text/border/text-background/text-decoration colors, opacity, scrollbar width, box shadows, flex/alignment/basis, core text/font family, text decoration lines/colors/styles/thickness, line clamp, grid count/span/line-placement helpers, and image-only object-fit/grayscale options plus the shared GPUI spacing scale; additional Style, Styled, StyleRefinement, and node-specific operations should be added here before they are exposed.

operations.name: overflow
operations.gpui_mapping: Styled overflow helpers and div scroll overflow helpers

operations.name: text_decoration_thickness
operations.gpui_mapping: Styled text_decoration_0/1/2/4/8 or underline thickness px
